findings.summary: The change adds a Today ordering rule (high-priority suggestions first) only in the goal entity and form field descriptions; the Today screen and suggestion-ordering spec are not updated, so they may conflict with it or leave it undefined.
findings.evidence: "Suggestions for high-priority goals are listed first on Today" / "high-priority suggestions come first on Today" — no corresponding change to the Today screen or suggestion ordering nodes in the diff

findings.summary: The new priority field is required, but the entity gives no default, while the form says the default is normal; existing goals without a priority are left unspecified.
findings.evidence: - { name: priority, type: "enum high|normal" } vs "priority high or normal, default normal"

findings.summary: The schedule-correctness criterion now covers priority changes, but priority only affects ordering on Today, not schedule computation, so the criterion conflates ordering with scheduling.
findings.evidence: "Fixed-clock fixtures cover zero logs, qualification, interval, depth and priority changes..."
